reasoning: A standard pictogram of a person walking with a backpack and walking stick, universally understood as hiking, trekking, or backpacking. It fits outdoor excursions, trail planning, permit booking, and rucking workouts well, and is clearly distinct from plain walking or running icons because of the pack and pole.
